businesses.business: title insurance, mortgage lending and life insurance

offering_description.value: Operates three segments: life insurance and pre-need funeral products, title insurance and escrow settlement services, and residential mortgage origination. Sells to consumers, funeral homes, home buyers, real estate professionals and lenders through agents, offices and loan officers.

primary_products.value: final expense life insurance; annuities; pre-need funeral insurance; title insurance policies; residential mortgage loans

primary_services.value: title and escrow settlement; mortgage origination and servicing; loan processing

customer_segment.value: B2C: home buyers, borrowers and individual life insurance and annuity policyholders; B2B: real estate agents, lenders, funeral homes and title agents

end_markets.value: residential real estate; life insurance; funeral services; mortgage finance

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: life insurance premiums, annuity deposits and investment income; service fees: title insurance premiums, escrow and settlement fees; transaction or usage fees: mortgage origination fees and gains on sale of loans
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites life and title insurance and originates mortgages sold to investors; service provider: escrow and settlement services for real estate transactions

geography_served.value: US national: Mainly western US states, with mortgage lending and insurance across many states

specialization.value: diversified: life insurance and cemetery/mortuary, title and escrow, and mortgage lending

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent life insurance agents and title agents; own locations: title offices and retail mortgage branches; direct sales: loan officers and funeral home pre-need sales
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; own locations; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state insurance regulators, CFPB, HUD and state mortgage licensing rules
